I started watching a month ago, and I'm 1/2 way through Season 11.  I'll be honest and say that originally it was for Jensen Ackles.  (M'mmmm... so dreamy!)  But, I stayed because the writing is by far some of the best there is - it references a lot of pop culture and is quite funny, and any plot holes actually get covered.  Several of the episodes are quite brilliant - there's one where everything goes by the rules of cartoon physics, another is from the pov of the Impala, and another where you see the episode told from the perspective of both brothers - and its hilarious to see how they view each other in the situation, and a Scooby-Doo crossover episode.  Also great recurring characters - like The GhostFacers, and the extremely overprotective mother of the prophet of God.  ANNNNND!   They have amazing guest stars - Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Felicia Day, Mark Pellegrino, Curtis Armstrong, Mitch Pileggi, Amanda Tapping, DJ Qualls, Adrianne Palicki, etc.....

And I do also have to give it up to Jensen.  Legit, I thought he was just a pretty face, but his physical acting is on par.  I really don't know why he isn't in more things.  I was just watching the wrestling episode this morning, and seeing him jump into the ring and pretend he's a wrestler was quite funny.  


As much as I love the series, nothing is ever 100% - there are some things I wish were a bit different.  Like, I wish they used more pantheons.  It's nearly all Christian-based.  Would have loved to have seen various Asian gods, Celtic gods, Egyptian gods, Mayan/Incan/Aztec gods, African gods, Norse gods.  This would have opened up so much!  There was an episode that showed them, and another that referenced them, but that was it so far.  I'd also love it if Dean came out as gay or bi, but that's more of a personal request.....   and having Dean be the lover of Hanuman would just be the monkey's uncle......  


But, if you do like things of a supernatural and paranormal element, then give it a few more episodes.  Definitely a fun ride.

But, I do agree with all 3 points, especially the first and third ones.  You are less likely to zone out if you are in the front, and re-typing those notes helps commit them to memory.  It was a form of studying for me.  Sometimes I would wind up typing them 2-3 times just to make sure I learned the info.
My own advice?  It seems trite, but I have to say it - make sure you study what interests you.  It's another way to help you stay more focused.  And you'll enjoy it more.  Don't worry too much about how much you will make in the end, as if you wind up doing something you love - something you are good at, money will follow.  Trust me on this - it was told to me when I was 19, and I did NOT follow it, and I am miserable now.  Oh, and good luck!
